# Flavor matrix and interval calculations

These are the expanded rational evaluations for Theorem Y.8a, proof component 3, on its changed canonical-reference Dirac branch. The source action, primitive scalars, ordered source parameters, physical calibration inputs, complete interval-verification argument and implementation-error allocations remain in [the owning construction](../../../appendices/appendix_y_baryon_asymmetry.md). The tables use its single common source word and fixed flavor labels.

For each real entry, the displayed notation is $[l/d,h/d]$ with $d>0$. A real and imaginary pair denotes the rectangle $[l_R/d_R,h_R/d_R]+i[l_I/d_I,h_I/d_I]$. Flavor indices are $1,2,3$ in the ordered bases of the construction. The diagonal phase and rephasing matrices use entries $11,22,33$; $(A)_{ij}$ indexes the already subscripted matrix $A$. Nominal intervals, physical implementation boxes and the absolute CP circuit probability budget have their separate roles. The shared source coordinates remain correlated across every table.

<a id="matrices-and-frames"></a>
